service.description: Create a draft template, or change one of the user's organizations' templates: the header when templateName is given (each header field takes the value given, an empty one clearing it: context, product, category and facility applicability, sample policy), itemList's characteristic changes (a draft item edited or removed in place; a published item is never edited in place: a change ends it and starts a new row now, a removal ends it), then action publish (stamps the draft items' from date) or retire. Refuses without QUALITY_TEMPLATE_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); another organization's template (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); a retired one (TEMPLATE_RETIRED); no name (NAME_REQUIRED); invalid values (VALUE_INVALID, LIMITS_INVALID, SAMPLE_INVALID); an item of another template (ITEM_INVALID) or one already ended (ITEM_ENDED); a change of a published template or a retirement without a reason (REASON_REQUIRED); publishing with no item (NO_ITEMS) or twice (TEMPLATE_PUBLISHED).

parameter.name: organizationPartyId
parameter.description: For a new template; the user's active organization by default.

parameter.name: itemList
parameter.description: Maps: inspectionTemplateItemId (empty adds one), characteristicName, readingTypeEnumId, uomId, lowerLimit, upperLimit, targetValue, mandatory, sequenceNum, description, remove.

service.description: A template of the user's organizations with its characteristics as of asOfDate (now by default), its draft characteristics, and its revision history: every characteristic row with its dates and the header's audit-logged changes. Refuses another organization's template (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).
The templates of the user's organizations by state, context, product and name, a page at a time.

A draft inspection of a source: an asset (its facility, product, lot and on-hand quantity), a receipt (its asset, shipment and order line; one open inspection per receipt), or a facility and product; the template given (published, of the facility's owner) or the published one that applies (product, category, any; facility first), whose items it reads as of now; its sample by the template's policy; the stock held when the asset is quarantined; the customer demand of a run's OrderItemWorkEffort when none is given. A receipt that needs inspection creates it in the receipt's own operation (receive#ShipmentStock). Refuses without QUALITY_INSPECT (PERMISSION_DENIED); a record outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); no product (PRODUCT_REQUIRED); a quantity not above zero (QUANTITY_INVALID) or above on hand (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ON_HAND); a template not published for the organization (TEMPLATE_UNAVAILABLE); an inspector who is not one of the organization's (INSPECTOR_INVALID); a sample outside 1 to the quantity (SAMPLE_INVALID); a second open inspection of a receipt or an asset (INSPECTION_EXISTS); an asset that is not the receipt's (VALUE_INVALID); a demand order item that is not the facility owner's sale of the product, in the user's organizations, given or from the run (DEMAND_INVALID).

parameter.name: reinspectQualityInspectionId
parameter.description: A disposed inspection whose stock is still held (Quarantine, Rework, a return): the new inspection takes its receipt and held asset, and the held quantity moves to it (NOT_HELD otherwise).

service.description: Assign work on an open inspection: its inspector (empty unassigns) and due date, and while it is a draft with no readings its template (read as of now). Never changes its status or result. Refuses without QUALITY_INSPECT, QUALITY_VERIFY or QUALITY_DISPOSE (PERMISSION_DENIED); an inspection outside the user's organizations or facilityIds (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); a closed one (INSPECTION_CLOSED); an inspector who is not one of the organization's (INSPECTOR_INVALID); a new template once there are readings (TEMPLATE_FIXED) or one not published (TEMPLATE_UNAVAILABLE).

Submit a draft inspection's result once each mandatory characteristic has a reading: the accepted and rejected quantities, adding up to the quantity inspected, and the reason for a rejection; the result (accepted, partly accepted, rejected) follows; the organization's verifiers are notified (QualityInspectionDecision). Refuses without QUALITY_INSPECT (PERMISSION_DENIED); an inspection outside the user's organizations or facilityIds (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); one that is not a draft (INSPECTION_NOT_DRAFT); missing readings (READINGS_REQUIRED); quantities that do not add up (QUANTITY_MISMATCH); a rejection without a reason (REASON_REQUIRED).

Verify a submitted inspection (Verified: ready for disposition; verification alone releases no stock), or with approve false return it to its inspector with the reason (Draft, readings kept); its inspector is notified. A separate permission from inspecting, and never by the user who submitted it. Refuses without QUALITY_VERIFY (PERMISSION_DENIED); an inspection outside the user's organizations or facilityIds (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); one not waiting for verification (INSPECTION_NOT_SUBMITTED); the submitter (SELF_VERIFY); a return without a reason (REASON_REQUIRED).

Cancel a draft or submitted inspection with the reason; its stock stays where it is (a quarantined receipt with no other inspection counts as held and may be inspected again). Refuses without QUALITY_INSPECT or QUALITY_VERIFY (PERMISSION_DENIED); an inspection outside the user's organizations or facilityIds (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); a verified or closed one (INSPECTION_CLOSED); no reason (REASON_REQUIRED).

A disposition of part of a verified inspection, through the Warehouse posting guard (StockPosting.js): Release takes the accepted quantity, the others (Quarantine, Rework or repair, Return to customer, Return to supplier, Scrap, Use as is) the rejected. Release and Use as is first reserve the inspection's pegged customer demand (checked again: DEMAND_INVALID) on the released stock, keeping the order item's reservations (only its not-available quantity is reduced, then reserve#AssetForOrderItem with the asset) and then set AstAvailable through update#Asset, the only path out of quarantine (its AssetStatusAvailableReservations SECA gives the rest to waiting reservations), then move it to toLocationSeqId when given; Scrap sets AstMorgue (moving it to a morgue location when given) and calls WarehouseTaskServices.scrap#Asset with this disposition, in the one transaction; the others keep it quarantined, moved within quarantine when given. Each disposition is a record, queues the bill matches of the inspection's receipt (InvoiceMatchServices.queue#MatchReevaluation) and notifies the inspector; the inspection is Disposed once nothing is left. A retry with the same operation key answers the first disposition. Lock order: the inspection, its asset, the location. Refuses without QUALITY_DISPOSE (PERMISSION_DENIED); an inspection outside the user's organizations or facilityIds (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); one not verified (VERIFICATION_REQUIRED); no disposition (DISPOSITION_INVALID, VALUE_INVALID); a quantity not above zero (QUANTITY_INVALID), beyond what is left of its kind (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_RESULT) or on hand (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ON_HAND); a scrap of stock not held (NOT_HELD) or with a reason that is not a scrap reason (REASON_INVALID); a destination of the wrong type (LOCATION_NOT_MORGUE, LOCATION_NOT_QUARANTINE, LOCATION_INVALID), closed or missing; a closed fiscal period for the scrap (PERIOD_CLOSED).

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode DISPOSED, qualityInspectionId, dispositionSeqId, dispositionEnumId, quantity, assetId, resultAssetId, statusId, locationSeqId, reservedOrderId, reservedOrderItemSeqId, physicalInventoryId, heldQuantity, inspectionStatusId, and the operation fields.

service.description: One inspection of the user's organizations (in facilityIds when given): its header with names, its template's characteristics as of its creation with their readings, the readings, dispositions, what is left to dispose (accepted and rejected), the mandatory characteristics still without a reading, its history (audit-logged changes, readings, dispositions) and what the user may do now. Refuses another (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

The inspections of the user's organizations, in facilityIds when given, by status (or open ones), product, lot, inspector, source type, shipment, receipt and due date, a page at a time, the nearest due first.

For bill matching and planning (D21): each receipt of a receipt id, an order line or a shipment, with its accepted and dock-rejected quantity, its held quantity (the heldQuantity of its inspections, a re-inspection holding what it took from the earlier one; a receipt with no inspection whose stock is quarantined is held whole), what its inspections rejected (scrapped or returned to the supplier), what of that has left the stock (inspectionRemovedQuantity: the scrapped quantity and what Return to supplier dispositions sent back; the rest is still held), match-eligible (accepted less held and less inspection-removed, P14 review B1), and the totals. An internal read: the caller checks its own permission (as InvoiceMatch.js does). Refuses no source (SOURCE_REQUIRED).
A file of an inspection of the user's organizations, for a user who inspects, verifies or disposes (PERMISSION_DENIED, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).
